title: SmoothGuard: Defending Multimodal Large Language Models with Noise Perturbation and Clustering Aggregation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical defense framework (SmoothGuard) for Multimodal Large Language Models to improve robustness against adversarial attacks and jailbreaking. While it utilizes the MM-SafetyBench benchmark which includes categories like 'Hate Speech' and 'Illegal Activity', the study is centered on adversarial security and model robustness rather than evaluating religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
